name: inspira-text-reveal
blurb: Text is hidden behind a mask that wipes away on scroll.
description: Text element has a clip-path or mask that expands as you scroll into view, progressively revealing the content.
use_when: Key messages or headlines in a scrolling narrative that deserve a graceful entrance.
avoid_when: Static/non-scroll pages — the reveal may never trigger.
a11y: Content may be unreachable if the mask does not fully expand. Tab order depends on unmask state.
